name: Honeymoon Package to Cairo, Alexandria and Hurghada
description: Your first trip as a married couple should be remarkable, it should be full of fun, Ibis Egypt Tours offering Honeymoon Packages to Cairo, Alexandria and Hurghada, spend an amazing Egypt Honeymoon while exploring the Great Pyramids of Giza, Montazah palace, relax at Hurghada and more with Honeymoon in Egypt.
overview: Your first trip as a married couple should be remarkable, it should be full of fun, Ibis Egypt Tours offering Honeymoon Packages to Cairo, Alexandria and Hurghada, spend an amazing Egypt Honeymoon while exploring the Great Pyramids of Giza, Montazah palace, relax at Hurghada and more with Honeymoon in Egypt.

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairo
itinerary.description: Once your flight landing at cairo Airport, Ibis Egypt tours representative will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name, then he will transfer you to your hotel in Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo Day Tour
itinerary.description: Ibis Egypt tours representative will pick you up from your hotel after enjoying the relish of your breakfast, enjoy your sightseeing tours to Pyramids of Giza, the ruins of Memphis City, and Sakkara Step Pyramid start your tour by visiting the three Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren and Mykerinus, then move to Panorama area, enjoy fabulous photos for the three Pyramids, next move to the Sphinx, visit the Valley Temple, Enjoy Lunch at local restaurant in Cairo, continue your tour by visiting the ruins of Memphis City including the Open Air Museum of Ramses II, finally visit Sakkara Step pyramid, at the end of your day tours back to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy Tasty breakfast at your hotel, then start to embrace Cairo culture by visiting the Egyptian Museum, it is one of the most famous museums in the world , then move to the remarkable site Citadel of Salah El-Dein and the Alabaster Mosque, enjoy tasty Egyptian lunch at local restaurant, next round will be to Old Cairo including visits to the various Churches there ( Visit maximum 02 churches ), visit Ben Ezra Synagogue, at the end of your tour back to hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo Dinner Cruise
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast at hotel, manage to relax in the morning, be ready for a fantastic Dinner Cruise with Belly Dancer at night, Ibis Egypt tours representative will pick you up from your hotel at 06:00 pm., then he will escort you to your dream dinner Cruise, you will be welcomed by Egyptian Zaffa, ( Egyptian band ) and folklore show upon arrival, enjoy listening to oriental Egyptian music of drams & flutes for the first time, embarkat to your Cruise, enjoy tasty buffet dinner while sailing for two hours on the magic Nile River, watch real Belly Dancer, enjoy watching dancing by sticks, Tannora is an important show of the pary, at the end of your Dinner cruise transfer back to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Alexandria Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast at hotel, Today is different day, as you will visit Alexandria city located at the Mediterranean Sea by air-conditioned vehicle, where you can taste different culture by visiting Cata Comb of Kom El-Shokafa, Qaitbai Citadel, and Alexandria Library from outside, walk through the magnificent Montazah Palace, or try to amuse your eyes by visiting Roman amphitheatre ( If visit was allowed ), manage to relax by having lunch at local restaurant, then drive back to Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo to Hurghada
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo domestic airport, catch your flight to Hurghada, meet & assist at hurghada airport, transfer to hotel, it is your chance to escape the crowds, manage to relax at the stunning beaches of Hurghada, different water activities are waiting for you including swimming, diving or snorkeling. Overnight in Hurghada

itinerary.title: Hurghada Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Hurghada quad runner station, try different adventure in Hurghada by driving your quad runner around 25 Km. to scout Hurghada Desert, you will pass by Bedouin village, feel the traditional life of the Bedouin, taste the Bedouin tea, smoking water pipe is another experience, at the end of your quad runner round, back to the quad runner station, then Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you back to your hotel in Hurghada. Overnight in Hurghada

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure in Hurghada
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at your hotel, it is your chance to escape the crowds, manage to relax at the stunning beaches of Hurghada, optional excursion to tuck into spectacular islands like Mahmya and Tiran Island, plenty of water activities are waiting for you, swimming, diving or snorkeling are available, Or Enjoy optional at night to ALF LIELA W LIELA SHOW. Overnight in Hurghada

itinerary.title: Back to Cairo
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at hotel, today is your flight back to Cairo, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Hurghada Airport, catch your flight back to Cairo, meet & assist at Cairo domestic Airport, transfer to hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Today we will say goodbye to Egypt, once you enjoy your tasty breakfast, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo International airport for final departure.
